diagnosis.narrative: The series shows no clear long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.236), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single THETA' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.0233. Series context: trend strength 0.0235 and seasonal strength 0.7339; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.236); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.957.
